title: Zero Hour
paragraphs: A 1970s mystery and suspense anthology hosted by Rod Serling, presenting both standalone dramas and serialized stories spread across a week of broadcasts.
1973-74 suspense anthology hosted by Rod Serling.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Five-part serial era (September 3, 1973 to April 26, 1974) and Standalone anthology era (April 29, 1974 to July 26, 1974).
The stories often return to death and mortal threat, murder and violent crime, and witnesses and testimony.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes 1970s commercial radio-drama revival and Five-day serial scheduling experiment.
plain_text:
A 1970s mystery and suspense anthology hosted by Rod Serling, presenting both standalone dramas and serialized stories spread across a week of broadcasts.

1973-74 suspense anthology hosted by Rod Serling.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Five-part serial era (September 3, 1973 to April 26, 1974) and Standalone anthology era (April 29, 1974 to July 26, 1974).

The stories often return to death and mortal threat, murder and violent crime, and witnesses and testimony.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes 1970s commercial radio-drama revival and Five-day serial scheduling experiment.
